title: AgentToolSafetyService
responsibility: Brokers untrusted model tool proposals through current grants, independent screening, durable budget reservations and exact owner approval.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Trusted tool definitions, current agent policy, durable journal, clock and optional independent classifier.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.submit.agentId
inputs.description: Host-assigned identity for the agent whose grants apply.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.submit.proposal
inputs.description: Bounded, untrusted JSON with a tool name and exact tool arguments.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.approve.agentId
inputs.description: Host-assigned identity for the agent whose grants apply.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.approve.approvalId
inputs.description: One-use challenge ID returned to the authenticated reviewer.

inputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.approve.proposal
inputs.description: Bounded, untrusted JSON with a tool name and exact tool arguments.

outputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.submit
outputs.description: The admission decision, pending review, action result or execution failure. A grant revoked at dispatch returns a failed decision.

outputs.name: AgentToolSafetyService.approve
outputs.description: The decision after rechecking the exact approved proposal and current policy.
